465-585-2079-3742-4251.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

4302-4875-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4302-4875-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2921-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1981-2415-2921-4446.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

3129-7839-7926.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Your commander is on the battlefield.
3129-7839-7926.description:
Activate Slag Strider by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Primal Vigor.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1987-3110-3227.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3110-3227.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Scrivener.
When Scrivener enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3110-3227.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-647-1376.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-647-1376.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-2351-5434-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-5434-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

2187-3617-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Possessed Skaab and exiling Ephemerate.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1824-2530-6556-7349.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-6556-7349.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
1824-2530-6556-7349.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Diamond Mare triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2757-3459-5078-6918.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Battered Golem, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

539-2438-7085.description:
Cast Earth Kingdom General by paying its mana cost
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Earth Kingdom General
When Earth Kingdom General dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1723-2512-5639.notablePrerequisites: You have one or fewer cards in hand.
1723-2512-5639.description:
Activate Arm-Mounted Anchor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Arm-Mounted Anchor ability.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Starlit Sanctum's second ability by paying {W}, tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

1482-2854-4574-5741.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1482-2854-4574-5741.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3327-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-3327-6797.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

413-1548-3719-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven creatures, excluding Port Razer, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Port Razer or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
413-1548-3719-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping seven creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Port Raazer as attackers, triggering Luxurious Locomotive, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Deal combat damage using Port Razer, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Port Razer.
Resolve the Port Razer ability, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Port Razer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Port Razer enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1618-3617-6496--97.easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
1618-3617-6496--97.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Walk and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
1618-3617-6496--97.description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Time Walk and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Time Walk and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Time Walk and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Time Walk's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
1618-3617-6496--97.notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

2034-4125-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2034-4125-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Shipwreck Dowser and at least two other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing three of the creatures returned in step 1, adding six {C}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

997-5276-6412.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Pre-War Formalwear from exile to the battlefield.
When Pre-War Formalwear enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Pre-War Formalwear to it.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

3017-5184-5742-5743.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-1379-3468.description:
Cast Red Sun's Twilight with X equal to 5 by paying {5}{R}{R}.
In response, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Red Sun's Twilight targeting itself and up to four other artifacts.
Resolve that copy, destroying all its targets then creating a token copy of each artifact destroyed.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2967-4871.description:
Activate Pashalik Mons by paying {3}{R} and sacrificing a Goblin.
The Goblin dies, triggering Pashalik Mons and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Pashalik Mons trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pashalik Mons ability from step 1, creating two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
The Goblin dies, triggering Pashalik Mons and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Pashalik Mons trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Blazing Sunsteel.

2210-2723.notablePrerequisites:
Blazing Sunsteel and Mirrormade attached to an indestructible creature you control.
You have a way to deal damage to the indestructible creature.
2210-2723.description:
Deal damage to the indestructible creature.
Blazing Sunsteel and Mirrormade trigger.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to any target.
Resolve the Mirrormade trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to the indestructible creature.
Repeat from step 2.

45-340-4067-4842-5116.notablePrerequisites: Nin does not have summoning sickness.
45-340-4067-4842-5116.description:
Tap Gilded Lotus for {U}{U}{U} and Khalni Gem for {R}{R}.
Pay this mana to activate Nin, the Pain Artist's ability targeting Chasm Skulker.
Chasm Skulker gets 3 damage marked on it and goes to 1 toughness.
You draw 3 cards from Nin, the Pain Artist and Chasm Skulker gets 3 +1/+1 counters placed on it, making its toughness go back up to 7 with 3 damage marked on it for a net of 4.
Discard the three cards you drew from Nin, the Pain Artist to untap Gilded Lotus, Khalni Gem, and Nin, the Pain Artist.
Repeat.
